summary: All 5 first-pass findings confirmed at their original severities (4 high-confidence reproductions plus one minor framing correction on D8: official scoring is binary, so the zero-tests issue is test weakness, not partial-credit confusion). 17.1 is fixable cheaply with two prompt/docstring edits (state the exact 'e{i}{j}' naming and the position-based value convention) keeping the frozen targets. 17.2 is a genuine blocker: the frozen targets reproduce the source blog's raw intermediate sympy cross-products (with a region-2 orientation-cancellation bug) and match no correct DOS under any constant prefactor (ratios 3.207/0.903/3.207, wrong energy scaling); it requires target regeneration to [0.125, 0.71, 0.08] plus an explicit Omega_T = Omega_BZ convention statement.
